annotations.text:
What these screens demand from the API

Every list card needs: item count, is_ranked, the first 3 items, comment count, created_at, slug. That is more than a lists row holds - the endpoint has to join and count.
The feed is only 'lists from people you follow, newest first'. No events or activity table needed - just a join through follows. Keep it that way as long as possible.
Open question: a 'worst of' list looks identical to a 'best of' one. Gold still marks rank 01. If worst-lists should read differently, that is the kind column we deliberately skipped.
